probes.identity_review: Opening identifies expected report title and year; ECB/EMI issuer and month where present match the historical report.

method: Ten bounded same-basename /pub/pdf/conrep/ hypotheses after pinned primary 404 failures. Each PDF opening was reviewed for the expected report title, issuer and year; month checked where present. Runtime requires exact URL and SHA-256. Shared Collector enforces robots and five-second pacing.
limitations: Probe characters are not additional stored corpus or verified tokenizer counts.
No generic URL rewrite is authorized by these samples.
Publisher date metadata can differ from report cutoffs; year/title identify the 2002 report.
This resolves ten known retrieval paths, not institution-wide discovery or unsupported formats.
